description:
Benchmark two implementations of a data processing function and keep the faster one if output is identical. Files are in /home/ga/workspace/benchmark_task/: data_processor.py (main script with current implementation), optimized_transform.py (suggested optimized function), test_data.json (1000 test records). Steps: (1) Run 'python data_processor.py test_data.json' and note the execution time printed, (2) Save output for comparison: 'cp output.json output_original.json', (3) Replace the transform_records() function in data_processor.py with the version from optimized_transform.py, (4) Run 'python data_processor.py test_data.json' again and note new time, (5) Verify outputs match using 'diff output_original.json output.json' or manual inspection, (6) Create benchmark_report.txt with format: 'BENCHMARK RESULTS
=================
Original Time: X.XXX seconds
Optimized Time: Y.YYY seconds
Performance Improvement: Z.Z% faster/slower
Output Verification: PASS/FAIL
Decision: KEPT OPTIMIZED / REVERTED TO ORIGINAL', (7) If optimized is faster AND output matches, keep optimized version in data_processor.py; otherwise revert to original implementation.
